name: io.github.youthmy11-ai/forgesuite-mcp
title: ForgeSuite Web3, FinOps, Brand, Web Extract & Media MCP
description: Zero-install Remote Streamable-HTTP (https://forgeaudit-x402.forgesuite-x402-edge.workers.dev/mcp) and Node 20+ stdio MCP server (v1.6.0, 11 tools — run locally via `npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`): envshield_scan, calldata_decode, tokencost_estimate, cryptobill_quote, evm_token_risk_scan, solana_mint_risk_scan, brand_domain_handle_scan, multi_chain_wallet_scan, subtitle_caption_audit, media_brief_audit, and web_clean_extract.

tools.name: envshield_scan
tools.description: Scan .env, JSON, YAML, or code snippets offline for leaked API keys, private keys, mnemonics, JWTs, and webhook secrets.

tools.name: calldata_decode
tools.description: Decode raw hexadecimal EVM transaction calldata (ERC-20, Permit2, Uniswap, Multisend) and flag unlimited approvals.

tools.name: tokencost_estimate
tools.description: Calculate per-call and monthly LLM/agent token spend across frontier models with prompt-caching discounts.

tools.name: cryptobill_quote
tools.description: Generate deterministic self-custody crypto invoice links and Solana Pay SPL-USDC / EIP-681 BEP20 / TRON payment URIs.

tools.name: evm_token_risk_scan
tools.description: Live EVM token and smart contract bytecode, EIP-1967/1167 proxy, opcode (SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL), and rug/honeypot selector audit across Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum.

tools.name: solana_mint_risk_scan
tools.description: Live Solana Mainnet SPL Token and Token-2022 mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, permanentDelegate, transferFeeConfig, transferHook, and Top-10 holder concentration risk audit.

tools.name: brand_domain_handle_scan
tools.description: Check candidate brand/project names across authoritative RDAP + Google DoH domains (.com, .io, .ai, .dev, .app, .org), npm/PyPI/GitHub registries, Bluesky/Reddit handles, and Apple iOS App Store.

tools.name: multi_chain_wallet_scan
tools.description: Inspect 1 to 5 EVM (0x...) and/or Solana (Base58) wallets across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, and Solana Mainnet for native & stablecoin balances, nonces, EIP-7702 delegations, Gnosis Safe M-of-N signers, SPL/Token-2022 holdings, and recent Solana signatures.

tools.name: subtitle_caption_audit
tools.description: Audit .srt and .vtt subtitle tracks offline for timestamp overlaps, CPS > 20 reading speed, 9:16 vertical safe-zone line width, mid-sentence cuts, and brand term fidelity — returning a 0–100 quality score plus normalized .srt/.vtt output.

tools.name: media_brief_audit
tools.description: Audit AI media briefs and spoken voiceover scripts offline: counts Latin & CJK words/syllables, computes 135/150/165 WPM durations vs target seconds, flags FFmpeg atempo > 1.20x distortion or < 0.85x drag, checks likeness consent, copyright & trademark safety (0–100), and outputs 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, and 4:5 agent JSON specs.

tools.name: web_clean_extract
tools.description: Fetch any public HTTP/HTTPS web page with strict IPv4/IPv6 SSRF protection and extract clean LLM-ready Markdown, OpenGraph/JSON-LD metadata, HTML tables converted to CSV, and estimated LLM token savings versus raw HTML.
